idea-plugin.name: Disable Python Debug Console by Default
idea-plugin.description:
Hides the interactive Python debug console in the console tab of the debug tool window, so a debug session starts on the plain process output instead. This works around PY-61959, where the Settings | Build, Execution, Deployment | Console | Always show debug console option has no effect.

The debug console remains available through the Show Debug Console toggle of the console tab.
